title: (RHBA-2018:1211) Update to Fuse Integration Services 1.0 Images
portal_summary: Update to Fuse Integration Services 1.0 images to address Critical Security Advisory https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2018:1191.
portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse Integration Services 1.0 Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.3|x86_64
portal_solution:
This update consists of updated FIS 1.0 images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog). Note that there are no changes to the Maven dependencies in this update.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

FIS 1.0
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_jboss_fuse/6.2.1/html-single/fuse_integration_services_1.0_for_openshift/
portal_description: This advisory fixes critical security issues affecting FIS 1.0 (as listed in the referenced JIRA issues).
abstract: This advisory fixes critical security issues affecting FIS 1.0 (as listed in the referenced JIRA issues).
